source_replacements.CedarPooSpec/Transport/Wire.lean:
import CedarPooSpec.Transport.SourceTable

/-! Compositional JSON framing over complete, certified native fragments.
The certificate binds every embedded fragment to its actual JSON value. -/
namespace CedarPooSpec.Transport

mutual
inductive JsonEncoding : Lean.Json → List String → Prop where
  | native (value : Lean.Json) : JsonEncoding value [value.compress]
  | array (values : List Lean.Json) (wires : List (List String))
      (items : JsonFragments values wires) :
      JsonEncoding (.arr values.toArray) (["["] ++ (wires.intersperse [","]).flatten ++ ["]"])
  | object (keys : List String) (values : List Lean.Json) (wires : List (List String))
      (lengths : keys.length = values.length) (unique : keys.Nodup)
      (items : JsonFragments values wires) :
      JsonEncoding (Lean.Json.mkObj (keys.zip values))
        (["{"] ++ (((keys.zip wires).map fun (key, wire) =>
          [(Lean.Json.str key).compress, ":"] ++ wire).intersperse [","]).flatten ++ ["}"])

inductive JsonFragments : List Lean.Json → List (List String) → Prop where
  | nil : JsonFragments [] []
  | cons (head : JsonEncoding value wire) (tail : JsonFragments values wires) :
      JsonFragments (value :: values) (wire :: wires)
end

theorem JsonFragments.length_eq (fragments : JsonFragments values wires) :
    values.length = wires.length := by
  induction values generalizing wires with
  | nil => cases fragments; rfl
  | cons value values ih =>
    cases fragments with
    | cons _ tail => simpa using congrArg Nat.succ (ih tail)

/-- A value and a lazy encoding with a complete compositional JSON certificate. -/
structure EncodedJson where
  value : Lean.Json
  rendering : Thunk { chunks : List String // JsonEncoding value chunks }

def EncodedJson.chunks (encoded : EncodedJson) : List String := encoded.rendering.get.val
def EncodedJson.wire (encoded : EncodedJson) : String := String.join encoded.chunks
theorem EncodedJson.certified (encoded : EncodedJson) :
    JsonEncoding encoded.value encoded.chunks := encoded.rendering.get.property
theorem EncodedJson.wire_eq (encoded : EncodedJson) :
    encoded.wire = String.join encoded.chunks := rfl

def EncodedJson.native (value : Lean.Json) : EncodedJson :=
  ⟨value, Thunk.mk fun _ => ⟨[value.compress], JsonEncoding.native value⟩⟩

def EncodedJson.snapshot (source : SourceSnapshot kind) : EncodedJson :=
  ⟨source.value, Thunk.mk fun _ => ⟨[source.wire],
    by simpa only [source.encoded] using JsonEncoding.native source.value⟩⟩

private theorem fragments (items : List EncodedJson) :
    JsonFragments (items.map (·.value)) (items.map (·.chunks)) := by
  induction items with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons head tail ih => exact .cons head.certified ih

def EncodedJson.array (items : List EncodedJson) : EncodedJson :=
  ⟨.arr (items.map (·.value)).toArray, Thunk.mk fun _ =>
    ⟨["["] ++ ((items.map (·.chunks)).intersperse [","]).flatten ++ ["]"],
      JsonEncoding.array _ _ (fragments items)⟩⟩

def EncodedJson.object (fields : List (String × EncodedJson))
    (unique : (fields.map Prod.fst).Nodup) : EncodedJson :=
  let keys := fields.map Prod.fst
  let children := fields.map Prod.snd
  ⟨Lean.Json.mkObj (keys.zip (children.map (·.value))), Thunk.mk fun _ =>
    ⟨["{"] ++ (((keys.zip (children.map (·.chunks))).map fun (key, wire) =>
       [(Lean.Json.str key).compress, ":"] ++ wire).intersperse [","]).flatten ++ ["}"],
      JsonEncoding.object _ _ _ (by simp [keys, children]) unique (fragments children)⟩⟩

end CedarPooSpec.Transport

def evaluate {α : Type} (produce : Unit → Except String α) : IO α :=
  match produce () with
  | .ok json => pure json
  | .error message => throw (IO.userError message)

/-- Keep compression inside the IO span: pure let bindings may be sunk past clocks. -/
@[noinline] private def serialize (json : Transport.EncodedJson) : IO (List String) :=
  pure json.chunks

/-- Consume complete encoded fragments without allocating another catalog-sized
string. The temporary list prefix can retire as each fragment is written. -/
private def writeChunks (stdout : IO.FS.Stream) : List String → IO Unit
  | [] => stdout.putStr "\n"
  | chunk :: rest => do
      stdout.putStr chunk
      writeChunks stdout rest

@[noinline] private def prepareSources (outputs : List (String × (Unit → Except String Transport.Entry))) :
    IO Transport.EncodedJson :=
  evaluate (fun _ => Transport.prepareCatalogFrom outputs)

private def phase (started : Option Nat) (name : String) : IO Unit := do
  if let some start := started then
    let elapsed := (← IO.monoNanosNow) - start
    (← IO.getStderr).putStrLn (Lean.Json.mkObj [
      ("observation", Lean.toJson "native-phase"), ("phase", Lean.toJson name),
      ("elapsed_ns", Lean.toJson elapsed)]).compress

def run (args : List String) (observe : Bool := false) : IO Unit := do
  let started ← if observe then pure (some (← IO.monoNanosNow)) else pure none
  match args with
  | "catalog" :: requested => do
      for name in requested do
        unless entries.any (fun entry => entry.1 == name) do
          throw (IO.userError s!"unknown manifest: {name}")
      let selected := if requested.isEmpty then entries else
        entries.filter (fun entry => requested.contains entry.1)
      -- Factories are consumed one at a time; no complete raw catalog is retained.
      let encoded ← prepareSources selected
      phase started "sources-ready"
      let chunks ← serialize encoded
      phase started "serialized"
      writeChunks (← IO.getStdout) chunks
      phase started "output-written"
  | ["all"] => do
      let outputs ← entries.mapM fun (name, produce) => do
        let json ← evaluate (fun _ => do (← produce ()).toJson)
        pure (name, json)
      for (name, json) in outputs do
        IO.FS.writeFile s!".lake/build/{name}-manifest.json" json.compress
  | [name] =>
      match entries.find? (fun entry => entry.1 == name) with
      | some (_, produce) => do
          let json ← evaluate (fun _ => do (← produce ()).toJson)
          IO.println json.compress
      | none => throw (IO.userError s!"unknown manifest: {name}")
  | _ => throw (IO.userError "expected a manifest name or all")

end CedarPooSpec.Manifests

import CedarPooSpec.Transport.SourceCatalog

namespace CedarPooSpec.Transport.SourceTableTest
open LeanPoo.Functional.ObjectContract

def initial : SourcePool .policy := {}
def sample : Lean.Json := Lean.Json.mkObj [("source", Lean.toJson "full policy")]

theorem arbitrary_source_bound (pool : SourcePool kind) (source : Lean.Json) :
    (pool.publish source).next.resolve (pool.publish source).reference = some source.compress :=
  pool.publish_bound source

theorem arbitrary_source_frame (pool : SourcePool kind) (source : Lean.Json)
    (index : Nat) (present : index < pool.entries.size) :
    (pool.publish source).next.entries[index]? = pool.entries[index]? :=
  pool.publish_frame source index present

theorem arbitrary_publication_contract (pool : SourcePool kind) (source : Lean.Json) :
    diagnose (sourceContract kind source.compress)
      ((pool.publish source).next, (pool.publish source).reference) = [] :=
  publication_contract pool source

-- Executable negative controls use the actual publisher and Contract.
#eval show IO Unit from do
  let first := initial.publish sample
  let hit := first.next.publish sample
  unless hit.reference.index == first.reference.index && hit.next.entries.size == 1 do
    throw (IO.userError "complete source reuse failed")
  let changed := hit.next.publish (Lean.toJson "different source")
  unless changed.next.entries.size == 2 do
    throw (IO.userError "changed source reused old reference")
  unless !(diagnose (sourceContract .policy sample.compress)
      (changed.next, changed.reference)).isEmpty do
    throw (IO.userError "forged source reference admitted")
  unless !(diagnose (sourceContract .policy sample.compress)
      (changed.next, ⟨999⟩)).isEmpty do
    throw (IO.userError "missing source reference admitted")
  IO.println "SOURCE-TABLE-CONTRACT-OK bound/frame/changed/missing/full-source"
theorem arbitrary_published_value (pool : SourcePool kind) (source : Lean.Json) :
    ((pool.publish source).next.entries[(pool.publish source).reference.index]?).map
      (fun snapshot => snapshot.value.compress) = some source.compress := publication_value pool source
#print axioms arbitrary_published_value
#print axioms arbitrary_source_bound
#print axioms arbitrary_source_frame
#print axioms arbitrary_publication_contract
end CedarPooSpec.Transport.SourceTableTest

-- Streaming must stop at the first factory or publication error.
#eval show IO Unit from do
  let failed := CedarPooSpec.Transport.sourceCatalogFrom
    [("first", fun _ => .error "first factory"), ("later", fun _ => .error "later factory")]
  match failed with
  | .error "first factory" => pure ()
  | _ => throw (IO.userError "factory error order changed")
  let uid : Cedar.Spec.EntityUID := ⟨⟨"User", []⟩, "cycle"⟩
  let store : Cedar.Spec.Entities := Cedar.Data.Map.make [
    (uid, ⟨Cedar.Data.Map.empty, Cedar.Data.Set.make [uid], Cedar.Data.Map.empty⟩)]
  let req : Cedar.Spec.Request := ⟨uid, uid, uid, Cedar.Data.Map.empty⟩
  let source : CedarPooSpec.Transport.SourceSnapshot .policy :=
    CedarPooSpec.Transport.SourceSnapshot.ofJson
    (Lean.Json.mkObj [("staticPolicies", Lean.Json.mkObj []),
      ("templates", Lean.Json.mkObj []), ("templateLinks", Lean.toJson ([] : List Lean.Json))])
  let input : CedarPooSpec.Transport.Case := {
    name := "self-ancestor", revision := "source"
    policy := ⟨[], source, rfl⟩
    request := req, entities := store
    response := Thunk.mk fun _ => Cedar.Spec.isAuthorized req store []
    evaluated := rfl }
  let malformed := CedarPooSpec.Transport.sourceCatalogFrom
    [("first", fun _ => .ok (.manifest ⟨[input], none⟩)),
     ("later", fun _ => .error "later factory")]
  match malformed with
  | .error message =>
    if message == "later factory" then throw (IO.userError "publication error was deferred")
  | .ok _ => throw (IO.userError "malformed publication admitted")
  IO.println "SOURCE-CATALOG-FACTORY-OK first-factory/first-publication-error"

-- The real composed encoder must escape keys/values and retain every fragment.
#eval show IO Unit from do
  let source : CedarPooSpec.Transport.SourceSnapshot .policy :=
    CedarPooSpec.Transport.SourceSnapshot.ofJson
    (Lean.Json.mkObj [("unicode", Lean.toJson "μ\nquoted\"")])
  let encoded := CedarPooSpec.Transport.EncodedJson.object [
    ("array", .array [.snapshot source, .native (.bool true), .native .null]),
    ("number", .native (Lean.toJson (17 : Nat))),
    ("text", .native (Lean.toJson "comma,colon:bracket]"))] (by simp)
  unless encoded.wire == encoded.value.compress do
    throw (IO.userError "certified canonical fragment wire differs")
  let unsorted := CedarPooSpec.Transport.EncodedJson.object [
    ("z", .snapshot source), ("a", .native (Lean.toJson "escaped"))] (by simp)
  unless (Lean.Json.parse unsorted.wire).toOption.map (·.compress) ==
      some unsorted.value.compress do
    throw (IO.userError "fragment value binding or key escaping failed")
  IO.println "CERTIFIED-JSON-FRAGMENTS-OK escaping/order/full-values"
